description: Dependency updates (ADR-0007, ADR-0009, ADR-0025). Conventional Commit messages size the next release for release-please and buildlogic.git-version: fix(deps) → patch release; ci(deps) for CI-only updates releases nothing.

packageRules.description: Spring Boot plugin and BOM move together (ADR-0007: 4.x minors tracked, majors by decision).
The Deephaven server image pinned for the ITs and the Deephaven Java client stay on one version (test-infra/compose/versions.env, gradle/libs.versions.toml).
Company base images, published outside this repository, are tagged <yyyymmdd>-<n> (ADR-0009).
Workflow actions (majors pinned) are CI-only changes.
yq, put on the runner by setup-yq (.github/versions.env), is a CI-only change.

The public fallbacks of the company base images (.github/versions.env, ADR-0033) are a CI-only change here, and the JRE and the JDK move together. Their tags float within Java 21, so the only update is a new Java major, a decision of its own (ADR-0007): it waits for approval on the dashboard.
kind and kubectl track the kind release's default node image; bump them together (test-infra/kind/versions.env).

customManagers.description: Test-infra images pinned as <image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest> in test-infra/compose/versions.env (ADR-0025).

Runner tools and the base-image fallbacks pinned in test-infra/kind/versions.env and .github/versions.env: a `# renovate:` hint names the datasource and package of the KEY=value line below it; the version is the value, or the tag after its last ':' for an image reference (ADR-0021, ADR-0033).
